sources.title: VoxCPM2 - Advanced AI Voice Generation & Cloning
sources.snippet: VoxCPM2 is an AI voice generation tool with three modes: Voice Design, Controllable Cloning, and Ultimate Cloning. Try the live demo free.

sources.title: VoxCPM2 · Models
sources.snippet: VoxCPM2 is a tokenizer-free, diffusion autoregressive Text-to-Speech model — 2B parameters, 30 languages, 48kHz audio output, trained on over 2 million hours of multilingual speech data.

sources.title: VoxCPM2 | AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: VoxCPM2 is OpenBMB's open-source tokenizer-free multilingual text-to-speech model for natural speech generation, voice design, and controllable voice cloning. It is a 2B-parameter model trained on over 2 million hours of speech, supports 30 languages, and produces 48 kHz studio-quality audio with real-time streaming capability.
